name: Keka
description: Keka is a comprehensive HR and payroll management platform designed to streamline and automate various human resource processes. It offers features such as employee management, attendance tracking, leave management, payroll processing, and performance evaluation, making it an essential tool for businesses looking to enhance their HR operations.
